jobs.description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem. Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. jobs.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
jobs.description: Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure. A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market. Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance. *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. data, risk, compliance, legal, marketing, sales, support, and partners behind one cohesive strategy Some things that might make you successful in a role like this: A leader with great product chops, commercial instinct to grow the business, and discipline to run it safely A high bar for craft – leading a creative, customer-centered, data-driven and experimentation-oriented approach Enthusiasm for building AI- and agent-powered products that drive spectacular customer experiences Exceptional cross-functional leadership across engineering, design, risk, compliance, finance, and partners 10+ Throughout, you will lead execution end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and delivering measurable outcomes. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI & Agents
jobs.description: About Cloaked Cloaked is a privacy startup dedicated to rebuilding consumer trust in how personal data is used. Nearly a million paying members use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them. That covers masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through. We've protected tens of millions of identities, screened hundreds of millions of calls, and removed billions of records from data brokers. Backed by a $375M Series B. About the Role This role is a Senior Product Manager on the Agents and Automation team. Our members trust us with high-stakes tasks involving their most sensitive information. We build personalized AI that connects to their inbox, their incoming calls, and the apps they use, spots what needs attention, and handles it in the background: removing their data, screening spam, and acting on their behalf, all while ensuring they stay in control the whole way. You'll own the systems and experiences behind that work: what it can do, how well it does it, how it knows what to do, all the surfaces it protects, and how members come to trust it enough to let us do more. We're looking for people who find problems and solve them. You'll find where things break for members, own each problem until it's fixed, and make sure it stays fixed. What will you do? • Find the problems yourself: talk to members, dig into reports, chat transcripts, and data to see where the AI falls short • Own each outcome to the finish: prove it's fixed and leave monitors so we know if it breaks. Don't stop at filing a ticket • Lead engineers and designers through the work and clear their blockers • Own how Cloaked's AI acts for members: what they can ask it to do, the work it takes on, how it feels to use, and how members see what was done, with proof, so they trust it with more • Build evaluations that ensure the quality, safety, and consistency of what our systems do for members • Decide which jobs we take on next, and which we don't, with a sharp point of view on how they get done and where they go wrong • Measure it like a product: task success, how often a person steps in, repeat use, cost per run, and the effect on retention and revenue per member. Then push those numbers and make the case for where we invest next • Prototype new flows yourself with AI tools before asking for engineering time • Communicate progress, challenges, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders What skills and experiences will help you? • 5+ years in product, with consumer products you owned end to end • You've shipped AI or automation features to real users and dealt with what happens when they fail • You can make something technical feel simple for consumers • You understand how AI agents use tools and act for people, and you know how to judge when an AI product is good enough to ship • You can name metrics you moved, how you moved them, and the data that proved it • Data skills: comfortable with SQL, and able to identify, interpret, visualize, and improve metrics that drive business goals • You're technical. You can read code and hold your own in a design review • You build with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, and you can show us something you built • Plus points for privacy, security, identity, or AI safety and governance • Plus points for eval experience, especially for multi-step agent behavior and non-deterministic outcomes outside of simple LLM outputs • Plus points for using agents in your free time What do we like? • A get-it-done mindset. You don't wait to be asked to solve problems. We are driven to create solutions and resolve problems in a fast-paced environment • Comfort working with various teams across the org to determine the best solution • Passion for security and internet ethics with a commitment to service leadership • Startup or growth-stage company experience • Interest in data and analytics •
